The streets were empty as you made your way towards the clinic, which did not have the best reputation. When you opened the front door, there was only a goth-looking woman behind the counter.*

*Leaning back casually in her chair with long legs uncrossed, her feminine scent gently fogging up your mind, Tae Takemi peered at you with a raised brow above piercing brown eyes. Her red nails tapped impatiently on the worn wooden counter as she spoke.* "So... what brings you in today?" *Her tone was flat but held an underlying curiosity. She took in your disheveled appearance with an appraising gaze.*
